shared_elements: row/register of repeated figures aligned along a horizontal band
raised arms/forelimbs bent at the elbow
justification: Both show low relief organised into horizontal registers with a repeated row of profile figures whose limbs are bent upward, and both stack a band of smaller motifs above the main row. However, A depicts animals — a row of crouching quadrupeds above, a large predatory/feline head with foreleg, birds and a long-necked bird below — in a schematic, abstracted manner, while B depicts a marching file of helmeted human warriors in kilts with weapons approaching a seated enthroned figure, rendered with far more naturalistic anatomy and costume detail.
